content:
BUILT CoLAB will be holding a BIM Training Course (Introductory Level) in May, aimed at professionals in the AECO sector – Architecture, Engineering, Construction and Operation, working in SMEs, Start-ups or Public Administration Entities.

There will be 8 hours of training, spread over four 2-hour synchronous online sessions, which will aim to introduce the principles of applying the BIM methodology, from its fundamental concepts to its practical application. Participants will understand the role of BIM in the digitalisation of the AECO sector, familiarise themselves with the applicable regulations and standards, explore collaborative tools and methodologies and learn effective strategies for its implementation.

Detailed information, access conditions and registration form* available here.

This Training Action takes place as part of the DIGITALBuilt – European Digital Innovation Hub, which BUILT CoLAB is a part of, enabling organisations to find solutions that promote their digitalisation at more affordable prices, as it includes co-financing from the PRR and the European Union.

* Registration deadline: 16 April.
